package resultset_test

// Generator of go-oracle.json: what the frozen Go build computes for the
// inputs of the TypeScript port's result-set tests. The Go code is frozen, so
// this is kept as text. To regenerate at the freeze commit: copy it to
// internal/resultset/zz_oracle_test.go, run
// go test -count=1 -run TestZZOracle ./internal/resultset, delete the copy.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/benchmark"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset/resultsettest"
)

var pointers = regexp.MustCompile(`0x[0-9a-f]+`)

func problemsOf(s *resultset.Set) []string {
	out := []string{}
	for _, p := range s.Validate() {
		out = append(out, pointers.ReplaceAllString(p, "<pointer>"))
	}
	return out
}

func goldenScored(name string) *resultset.Set {
	advisory := func(severity, scope string) []func(*resultset.Finding) {
		return []func(*resultset.Finding){
			resultsettest.Evidence("advisory_severity", severity), resultsettest.Evidence("dependency_scope", scope)}
	}
	p := resultsettest.ScoredProject()
	switch name {
	case "benchmark-pass":
		p.Add("security.dependencies", "GHSA-high", false, advisory("high", "prod")...)
		p.Add("security.dependencies", "GHSA-mod-1", false, advisory("moderate", "prod")...)
		p.Add("security.dependencies", "GHSA-mod-2", false, advisory("moderate", "prod")...)
		for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
			p.Add("lint.correctness", "no-undef", false)
		}
		p.TestFiles(
			resultset.TestFileCount{File: "test/a.test.js", Found: 4, Passed: 4},
			resultset.TestFileCount{File: "test/b.test.js", Found: 4, Passed: 3},
		)
		p.Metric("quality.size", "lines.source_code:javascript_typescript", 1200, "lines")
		p.Set.Inventory.Size = []resultset.SizeCount{{Group: "file_class", Name: "source", Lines: 1200, NonBlankLines: 1000}}
	case "benchmark-fail":
		p.Add("package.install", "lockfile-out-of-sync", true)
		p.Status("tests.existing", resultset.StatusBlocked, "prerequisite_failed_project")
		p.Status("deps.tree", resultset.StatusBlocked, "prerequisite_failed_project")
		p.TestFiles()
	}
	s := p.Done()
	benchmark.Apply(s)
	return s
}

func TestZZOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out := map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "Go build of js-prueffactory at the freeze commit 238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
	}

	// Fingerprints.
	type fpCase struct {
		Check, Rule, Path, Text, Value string
		WithSuite                      map[string]string
	}
	fpInputs := [][4]string{
		{"syntax.parse", "SyntaxError", "src/a.js", "Unexpected token ';' at line 3"},
		{"syntax.parse", "SyntaxError", "src/a.js", "Unexpected token ';' at line 41"},
		{"lint.correctness", "no-undef", "src/\u00fc/\u00e4.js", "'x' is not defined. (12:5)"},
		{"tests.existing", "", "test/a.js", "a  b\tc\n d"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "Line 3, Column 4 and COLUMN 9 and line 7, column 2"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "file.js:10:20: boom"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "\u00a0nbsp\u0085nel\ufeffbom\u3000ideo\u2028ls\u200bzw x\u000bvt\u001fus"},
		{"x", "y", "p", ""},
		{"x", "y", "p", "emoji \U0001F600 \ufb01 \u01c5"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "inline:12abc"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "outline 5 newline 6 deadline 7 line 8"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "line 3, column"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "l\u0131ne 5 L\u0130NE 6 line \u0663"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "caf\u00e9 cafe\u0301"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "a\x00b"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "LINE 10, COLUMN 3"},
		{"x", "y", "p", "at line 12, column 7:3"},
	}
	var fps []fpCase
	for _, in := range fpInputs {
		f := resultset.NewFingerprint(in[0], in[1], in[2], in[3])
		fps = append(fps, fpCase{in[0], in[1], in[2], in[3], f.Value, map[string]string{
			"test:unit": f.WithSuite("test:unit").Value,
			"":          f.WithSuite("").Value,
			"\U0001F600": f.WithSuite("\U0001F600").Value,
		}})
	}
	out["fingerprints"] = fps

	// Quote, WithoutControls, LongestBacktickRun.
	type textCase struct{ In, Quote, WithoutControls string; Backticks int }
	var texts []textCase
	for _, in := range []string{
		"a && b", "`tick`", "``x`` y", "ctrl\x07bell\x1b[31m", "line1\r\nline2", "\u0085nel\u0085", "\u00a0nbsp",
		"\ufeffbom", "  spaced  ", "", "\x7f del \u009b csi", "\U0001F600", "a\u2028b", "x ```` y ` z", "\t\v\f",
	} {
		texts = append(texts, textCase{in, resultset.Quote(in), resultset.WithoutControls(in), resultset.LongestBacktickRun(in)})
	}
	out["texts"] = texts

	// Evidence cap.
	type capCase struct {
		Name, Kind   string
		TextBytes    int
		OriginalSize *int
		ArtifactPath string
		Text         string
	}
	frames := func(prefix string, n int) string {
		var b strings.Builder
		b.WriteString("Error: boom\n")
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			b.WriteString(prefix + "at fn (/app/x.js:1:1)\n")
		}
		return b.String()
	}
	capInputs := []struct{ name, kind, text string }{
		{"two-byte character across the cap", "tool_output", strings.Repeat("a", 4095) + "\u00e9" + strings.Repeat("b", 100)},
		{"three-byte character across the cap", "tool_output", strings.Repeat("a", 4094) + "\u20ac" + "b"},
		{"three-byte character ending at the cap", "tool_output", strings.Repeat("a", 4093) + "\u20ac" + "b"},
		{"four-byte characters", "tool_output", strings.Repeat("\U0001F600", 1025)},
		{"four-byte character across the cap", "tool_output", strings.Repeat("a", 4093) + strings.Repeat("\U0001F600", 2)},
		{"exactly the cap", "tool_output", strings.Repeat("y", 4096)},
		{"mixed", "tool_output", strings.Repeat("a\u00e9\u20ac\U0001F600", 500)},
		{"35 frames", "stack_trace", frames("    ", 35)},
		{"frames after NEL", "stack_trace", frames("\u0085", 31)},
		{"frames after NBSP", "stack_trace", frames("\u00a0", 31)},
		{"frames after BOM", "stack_trace", frames("\ufeff", 31)},
		{"frames with CRLF", "stack_trace", strings.ReplaceAll(frames("  ", 31), "\n", "\r\n")},
	}
	var caps []capCase
	for _, in := range capInputs {
		s := handMade()
		s.Findings[0].Evidence = []resultset.Evidence{evidence(in.kind, in.text)}
		s.Finalize()
		var ev resultset.Evidence
		for _, f := range s.Findings {
			if len(f.Evidence) > 0 {
				ev = f.Evidence[0]
			}
		}
		c := capCase{Name: in.name, Kind: in.kind, TextBytes: len(ev.Text), OriginalSize: ev.OriginalSize}
		if ev.ArtifactID != nil {
			for _, a := range s.Artifacts {
				if a.ID == *ev.ArtifactID {
					c.ArtifactPath = a.Path
				}
			}
		}
		if in.kind == "stack_trace" {
			c.Text = ev.Text
		}
		caps = append(caps, c)
	}
	out["evidenceCap"] = caps

	// Byte-wise order of Finalize: Finding paths, and sort.Strings.
	{
		s := handMade()
		paths := []string{"\ue000.js", "\U0001F600.js", "\uff5e.js", "z.js", "\u00e9.js", "Z.js"}
		var fs []resultset.Finding
		for i, p := range paths {
			f := s.Findings[0]
			f.ID = "k" + string(rune('a'+i))
			f.Locations = []resultset.Location{{Role: "primary", PathBase: "project_root", Path: p, Start: &resultset.Position{Line: 1}, FileSHA256: strings.Repeat("a", 64)}}
			fs = append(fs, f)
		}
		s.Findings = fs
		s.Finalize()
		var order []string
		for _, f := range s.Findings {
			order = append(order, f.ID+" "+f.Locations[0].Path)
		}
		out["findingOrderByPath"] = order
		strs := append([]string{}, paths...)
		strs = append(strs, "\uffff", "\U00010000", "\ud7ff", "", "a", "ab", "\u0080")
		sort.Strings(strs)
		out["sortedStrings"] = strs
	}

	// Canonical tie-break: Findings that agree on every key but their evidence.
	{
		s := handMade()
		base := s.Findings[0]
		var fs []resultset.Finding
		for i, text := range []string{"Zx", "&x", "<x", "ax", "\u2028x", "\U0001F600x", "\ue000x"} {
			f := base
			f.ID = "k" + string(rune('a'+i))
			f.Evidence = []resultset.Evidence{evidence("tool_output", text)}
			fs = append(fs, f)
		}
		s.Findings = fs
		s.Finalize()
		var order []string
		for _, f := range s.Findings {
			order = append(order, f.ID+" "+f.Evidence[0].Text)
		}
		out["findingOrderByCanonical"] = order
	}

	// Passed-tests artifact with text that Go's encoder escapes.
	{
		s := handMade()
		s.TestCases = []resultset.TestCase{
			testCase("test/<a>.js", "a & b <c>", resultset.TestPassed),
			testCase("test/a.js", "line\u2028sep \x07 \"q\" \\ \U0001F600", resultset.TestPassed),
		}
		s.TestCases[1].Flaky = true
		s.TestCases[1].Attempts = []resultset.TestAttempt{{Outcome: resultset.TestFailed, DurationMS: 2, Error: ptrStr("boom\n\tat x")}, {Outcome: resultset.TestPassed, DurationMS: 3}}
		s.Finalize()
		out["passedTestsArtifact"] = map[string]string{"path": s.Artifacts[0].Path, "content": string(s.Artifacts[0].Content)}
	}

	// Validation messages.
	validation := map[string][]string{}
	longText := strings.Repeat("y", resultset.MaxEvidenceBytes+1)
	full := map[string]func(s *resultset.Set){
		"evidence text over the cap": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Findings[0].Evidence = []resultset.Evidence{evidence("tool_output", longText)}
		},
		"cut evidence names no artifact": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			for i := range s.Findings {
				for k := range s.Findings[i].Evidence {
					s.Findings[i].Evidence[k].ArtifactID = nil
				}
			}
		},
		"cut evidence claims a smaller original": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			for i := range s.Findings {
				for k := range s.Findings[i].Evidence {
					n := 10
					s.Findings[i].Evidence[k].OriginalSize = &n
				}
			}
		},
		"stack trace with more than 30 frames": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Findings[0].Evidence = []resultset.Evidence{evidence("stack_trace", stackTrace(31))}
		},
		"truncated evidence count is wrong":         func(s *resultset.Set) { s.ReportCompleteness.TruncatedEvidence = 5 },
		"artifact content does not match its hash":  func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Content = []byte("changed") },
		"artifact path leaves the report folder":    func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Path = "../escape.txt" },
		"artifact path is absolute":                 func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Path = "/etc/passwd" },
		"artifact path is not clean":                func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Path = "artifacts//x/../y.txt" },
		"artifact path has a backslash":             func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Path = `artifacts\x.txt` },
		"artifact path is empty":                    func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Path = "" },
		"artifact path is dot":                      func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Path = "." },
		"artifact path ends with a slash":           func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Path = "artifacts/" },
		"artifact would overwrite report.md":        func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[0].Path = "report.md" },
		"two artifacts share a path":                func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Artifacts[1].Path = s.Artifacts[0].Path },
		"passed test case in the list":              func(s *resultset.Set) { s.TestCases[0].Outcome = resultset.TestPassed },
		"test case with an unknown outcome":         func(s *resultset.Set) { s.TestCases[0].Outcome = "weird\x07" },
		"failed test case with a never-run reason":  func(s *resultset.Set) { s.TestCases[0].NeverRunReason = ptrStr("x") },
		"never-run test case without a reason": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			for i := range s.TestCases {
				if s.TestCases[i].Outcome == resultset.TestNeverRun {
					s.TestCases[i].NeverRunReason = nil
				}
			}
		},
		"finding in a different context than its execution": func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Findings[0].ContextID = "C-0001" },
		"finding of a different Check than its execution":   func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Findings[0].CheckID = "tests.existing" },
		"scope completeness does not match the executions": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Summary.ScopeCompleteness.Completed = 0
		},
		"standard completeness without a ratio": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Summary.StandardCompleteness.Ratio = nil
		},
		"run completed although a selected Check did not complete": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Checks[0].Status = resultset.StatusBudgetExhausted
			s.Checks[0].Outcome = resultset.OutcomeUnknown
		},
		"finding ID is not in sequence": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			old := s.Findings[0].ID
			s.Findings[0].ID = "F-0042"
			for i := range s.Checks {
				for k := range s.Checks[i].FindingIDs {
					if s.Checks[i].FindingIDs[k] == old {
						s.Checks[i].FindingIDs[k] = "F-0042"
					}
				}
			}
		},
		"ID with the wrong prefix":   func(s *resultset.Set) { s.TestCases[0].ID = "X-0001" },
		"context ID of the wrong form": func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Contexts[2].ID = "C-12\u00e9" },
		"deselected by --fast although the Run was not fast": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			code := resultset.ReasonDeselectedByFast
			s.Checks[0].Selected, s.Checks[0].ReasonCode = false, &code
		},
		"Check both selected and deselected": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Selection.DeselectedChecks = append(s.Selection.DeselectedChecks, s.Selection.EffectiveChecks...)
		},
		"Finding refers to a Limitation the Report lacks": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Findings[0].Limitations = append(s.Findings[0].Limitations, "service_not_started")
		},
		"summary severity counts are wrong": func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Summary.FindingsBySeverity.Warning = 4 },
		"summary test counts are wrong":     func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Summary.TestCases.Todo = 2 },
		"exit code is wrong":                func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Run.ExitCode = 0 },
		"execution with an unknown outcome": func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Checks[0].Outcome = "odd \"one\"" },
		"not applicable execution that ran": func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Checks[0].Applicability = resultset.NotApplicable },
		"observations_only with a Gate":     func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Checks[1].Outcome = resultset.OutcomeObservationsOnly },
		"failed without a Gate":             func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Checks[0].Outcome = resultset.OutcomeFailed },
		"unselected execution with Findings": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Checks[1].Selected = false
		},
		"metric and service in unknown contexts": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Metrics = append(s.Metrics, resultset.Metric{ID: "M-0001", CheckID: "x", ContextID: "C-0404", Name: "n", Unit: "u"})
			s.Services = append(s.Services, resultset.Service{Family: "valkey", ComposeService: "cache", ContextIDs: []string{"C-0405"}})
		},
		"duplicate context IDs and an unknown test case reference": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Contexts = append(s.Contexts, s.Contexts[0])
			s.TestCases[0].ExecutionID = "E-0404"
			s.TestCases[0].FindingIDs = []string{"F-0404"}
		},
		"unknown evidence artifact and execution artifact": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			id := "A-0404"
			for i := range s.Findings {
				for k := range s.Findings[i].Evidence {
					s.Findings[i].Evidence[k].ArtifactID = &id
				}
			}
			s.Checks[0].ArtifactIDs = append(s.Checks[0].ArtifactIDs, "A-0405")
		},
	}
	for name, mutate := range full {
		s := fullSet()
		s.Selection.EffectiveChecks = []string{"syntax.parse"}
		if p := s.Validate(); len(p) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("baseline invalid: %v", p)
		}
		mutate(s)
		validation["fullSet: "+name] = problemsOf(s)
	}
	hm := map[string]func(s *resultset.Set){
		"finding points at an unknown execution": func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Findings[0].ExecutionID = "E-9999" },
		"finding points at an unknown context":   func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Findings[0].ContextID = "C-9999" },
		"duplicate finding ID":                   func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Findings[1].ID = s.Findings[0].ID },
		"passed outcome with Findings":           func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Checks[1].Outcome = resultset.OutcomePassed },
		"gate count does not match Findings":     func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Checks[1].Gate = 7 },
		"summary gate count is wrong":            func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Summary.Gates = 9 },
		"execution lists an unknown finding":     func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Checks[1].FindingIDs = append(s.Checks[1].FindingIDs, "F-4242") },
		"selected applicable Check never started": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Checks[0].Status = resultset.StatusNotStarted
		},
		"benchmark not requested but scored": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark = resultset.Benchmark{Status: resultset.BenchmarkNotRequested, Score: ptrF(50.0)}
		},
		"benchmark with an unknown status": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark = resultset.Benchmark{Status: "maybe"}
		},
		"benchmark not requested but a profile": func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Profiles.BenchmarkProfile = ptrStr("benchmark-v1-uncalibrated")
		},
	}
	for name, mutate := range hm {
		s := handMade()
		s.Finalize()
		s.Benchmark = resultset.Benchmark{Status: resultset.BenchmarkNotRequested}
		mutate(s)
		validation["handMade: "+name] = problemsOf(s)
	}
	str := func(s string) *string { return &s }
	num := func(v float64) *float64 { return &v }
	bm := map[string]struct {
		baseline string
		mutate   func(s *resultset.Set)
	}{
		"pass although a Gate fired": {"benchmark-fail", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Verdict = str("pass") }},
		"fail without a Gate":        {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Verdict = str("fail") }},
		"incomplete with a score":    {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Verdict = str("incomplete") }},
		"pass without a score": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark.Score, s.Benchmark.Status = nil, resultset.BenchmarkIncomplete
		}},
		"computed without a score": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark.Score, s.Benchmark.Verdict = nil, str("incomplete")
		}},
		"incomplete status with a score": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Status = resultset.BenchmarkIncomplete }},
		"score over 100":                 {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Score = num(101) }},
		"score with a fraction below 0":  {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Score = num(-0.25) }},
		"range upside down": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark.Range = &resultset.Range{Low: 80.25, High: 20}
		}},
		"range in exponent form": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark.Range = &resultset.Range{Low: 1e-7, High: 1234567}
		}},
		"no range": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Range = nil }},
		"no verdict": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Verdict = nil }},
		"no profile ID": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.ProfileID = nil }},
		"profile differs from profiles.benchmark_profile": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Profiles.BenchmarkProfile = str("other")
		}},
		"gate list misses a Gate": {"benchmark-fail", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.GateFindingIDs = nil }},
		"gate list holds a Finding that is no Gate": {"benchmark-fail", func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark.GateFindingIDs = append(s.Benchmark.GateFindingIDs, "F-0099")
		}},
		"no areas":       {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Areas = nil }},
		"no fingerprint": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Benchmark.Fingerprint = nil }},
		"contributions do not add up to the score": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark.Areas[0].Contribution = num(1)
		}},
		"contribution without a score": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) {
			s.Benchmark.Score, s.Benchmark.Status, s.Benchmark.Verdict = nil, resultset.BenchmarkIncomplete, str("incomplete")
		}},
		"summary gates differ": {"benchmark-fail", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Summary.Gates = 3 }},
		"benchmark section in a test mode Report": {"benchmark-pass", func(s *resultset.Set) { s.Run.Command = "test" }},
	}
	for name, m := range bm {
		s := goldenScored(m.baseline)
		if p := s.Validate(); len(p) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("baseline %s invalid: %v", m.baseline, p)
		}
		m.mutate(s)
		validation["scored: "+name] = problemsOf(s)
	}
	{
		s := resultsettest.ScoredProject().Done()
		s.Run.Command = "benchmark"
		validation["benchmark command without a benchmark section"] = problemsOf(s)
		s2 := resultsettest.Minimal()
		s2.Benchmark.Areas = goldenScored("benchmark-pass").Benchmark.Areas
		validation["test mode Report with benchmark areas"] = problemsOf(s2)
	}
	out["validation"] = validation

	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/go-oracle.json", append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func ptrStr(s string) *string    { return &s }
func ptrF(v float64) *float64    { return &v }
